verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Grafana serves an llms.txt at grafana.com/llms.txt with a structured documentation index. Docs pages are also available as raw Markdown via .md endpoints (probe-2), and many .md doc URLs across Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir and Cloud were retrieved directly, so an agent can be pointed at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of explicit agent-oriented usage guidance beyond the llms.txt index.
